brief: wave-1 piece W1-07 — Character creation (diegetic census office, 10 attrs / 19 skills, 10 races, birthsigns, custom class builder, 12x10 reaction matrix)
findings: RI-CHR01 §1 = 8 inputs (hatch-name, race, sex, upbringing, given name, class, birthsign, favoured attributes). Composition rule: attr = 10 + raceDelta + classDelta; sum(raceDelta)=12, sum(classDelta)=0 -> ALWAYS 112 points. skill = max(5, raceSkill, classSkill), 5..10 skills above baseline.
RI-CHR01 §5 signature = race(10) x class_family(6) x birthsign_family(3) x upbringing_class(3) = 540.

CORPUS CONTRADICTION FOUND: RI-PRG03 ships 19 skills including *Polearms*, but NO race in RI-CHR02 §1 and NO named class in RI-CHR01 §4 raises Polearms. RI-CHR01 method 3 asserts 'every one of the 19 skills is above baseline in >=1 race x class pair' — unsatisfiable on the named-class route as written. Resolution taken: ship the corpus tables verbatim, declare the gap in game/data/progression/KNOWN-GAPS.json, and prove Polearms IS reachable via route B (custom) and route C (questionnaire), which method 2 implies by counting '15 class options' (14 named + custom).

Corpus-mandated data paths: progression/creation.json, progression/races.json, progression/race-reactions.json, progression/birthsigns.json, progression/classes.json, dialogue/creation-questions.json.
Existing game/data/progression/skills.json (W1-00) has only 3 placeholder skills and levels.json declares 6 Souls attributes — both must be replaced with RI-PRG03's 19 and RI-PRG02's 10.
Engine loadData() buckets progression/*.json by doc.schema into out.progression — new files need bucket wiring in game/src/engine.js loadData().
game/src/combat/parley.js already reads world.dispositions keyed by npc_id — that is the natural AR-3 seam: race term -> disposition -> in-fight parley ground test at 60Hz.

Trace event vocabulary is closed: ... spawn despawn enemy_state quest_stage journal topic item load. parley_offer is NOT in it; RI-CHR02 method 8 demands a parley_offer event -> extensible by amendment, emitted as events[].type='parley_offer'.
